technical_conventions_for_review.push_duration: Original supplies distance but no duration; a declared transport duration may use the existing 0.35-second convention, without inventing a separate stun.
technical_conventions_for_review.initial_overlap: No source-authorized ejection or extra birth control. A movement beginning within the newly raised mountain should be allowed only while monotonically reducing penetration, then ordinary swept blocking resumes.
technical_conventions_for_review.collapse_geometry: Existing reviewed G18 map explicitly binds a rectangle to Q3-7/Q3-8. Its origin is the mountain center and direction is mountain-to-current-manual-mouse; no homing and no H05 width scaling.
technical_conventions_for_review.projectile_families: All actual enemy families (bolt, hex_bolt, lob) are included. Lob height is presentation only; original grants no aerial-projectile exception.
technical_conventions_for_review.expiry: Lifetime expires in inherited hero/actor time; pause/frozen-room time stays frozen, no natural-expiry collapse damage. Existing static arena/obstacle policy remains unchanged.

implementation_conventions.authority: Parent technical direction 2026-10-04 20:36 UTC; implementation/tunable conventions, not verbatim original source or user playtest acceptance
implementation_conventions.mountain_orientation: Long axis perpendicular to caster-to-selected-point; preview shows it. Coincident target uses stable last valid facing.
implementation_conventions.cooldown_start: First actual raise starts CD. Existing-mountain recast reuses root cast and bypasses only that CD.
implementation_conventions.H05_scope: Mountain length only; independent collapse width and length unchanged.
implementation_conventions.push_duration_note: Existing technical transport duration, no extra stun. H06 alone applies source 0.8s stun.
